content_metadata.description: A video presentation by Gerardo Iñiguez discussing the role of Human-Centered AI in addressing societal issues.

qAndA.answer: Assistant Professor at the Department of Network and Data Science at Central European University.
qAndA.question: What is Gerardo's position at the university?

qAndA.answer: Computational social science and network science, particularly focusing on online systems.
qAndA.question: What specific areas of research does Gerardo focus on?

qAndA.answer: He believes AI should benefit individuals and society by integrating ethics and social welfare considerations.
qAndA.question: Why does Gerardo think Human-Centered AI is important?

qAndA.answer: He is concerned about the dominance of private companies and corporate interests, urging researchers to shape ethical AI.
qAndA.question: What concern does Gerardo express about the current state of AI development?

qAndA.answer: His ambitious project aims to utilize ethical AI to address climate change challenges.
qAndA.question: What is Gerardo's 'blue sky' project?

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Perfect, so my name is Gerardo Innegas. I'm an assistant professor at the Department of Network and Data Science in Central European University.

What I do is research on computational social science and network science. The idea of this is we try to make mathematical models of the way people behave in online systems, how they share information, how they form opinions, how they form communities.
And what we really want is to understand what people do in order to try to make it better in the future.
Yes, I think the basic idea behind human-centric AI is the idea that we not only need to make algorithms in order to fulfill a certain purpose, but we need to make individuals and society better.
So we have to introduce values of ethics and of social welfare into the algorithms that are trying to solve issues.
I think it is a good project. It's something we need. Now most of the development in the AI is being done by private companies, you know, by corporate interests.
And researchers are just understanding how it behaves. We are not taking like an active role in also developing these algorithms.
So I think we need to create some sort of ecosystem between institutions, governments, researchers and companies to really make AI better and more ethical.
Sure. I think we live in a strange moment in society that we have very big problems. We have to solve. We have climate emergency, we have extreme inequality.
We have a lot of technology that we can use in order to solve this problem, but somehow we are very disconnected from this society and from this technology.
So I think we can use AI to make us better informed, to actually help us in looking for solutions to these big problems.
But we need that this AI is well engineered, that is not only made by companies, but is actually made by the researchers, by the governments, by corporations all put together.
And I think this is one of the only ways in which we are actually going to solve like giant problems like climate change.
I will use SkyProject this to solve climate change with well-informed and ethical AI.

What is your opinion on Human – Centered AI?

Yes, I think the basic idea behind a Human – Centered AI is the idea that we not only need to make algorithms to fulfil a certain purpose, but we need to make individuals and society better. We have to introduce values of ethics and of social welfare into the algorithms that are trying to solve issues. I think it is a good project, it is something we need. Now, most od the development in the AI is being done in private companies, by corporate interests and researches are just, you know, understanding how it behaves. We are not taking like an active role in also developing these algorithms. So, I think we need to create some sort of ecosystem between institutions, governments, researches and companies to really make AI better and more ethical.

I think we live in a strange moment in society, that we have very big problems that we have to solve. We have a climate emergency, we have extreme inequality, we have a lot of technology that we can use in order to solve these problems, but somehow, we are very disconnected from this, as a society, and from this technology. I think we can use AI to make use better informed, to actually help us in looking for solutions to these big problems. But we need that this AI is well engineered. That it is not only made by companies, but is actually made, you know, by the researches, by the governments, by corporations all put together. I think this is one of the only ways in which we’re actually going to solve giant problems, like climate change.

What would be your blue sky project in AI for Europe?

My blue sky project is to solve with well informant ethical AI.
